rule.backend.size_negative: Picture sizes for this model must be 0 or more; 0 means the video's own size.
rule.backend.size_not_multiple_of_32: Picture sizes for this model must be multiples of 32.
rule.backend.size_not_positive: Picture sizes for this model must be above 0; it cannot run at the video's own size.
rule.backend.unknown_variant: This model variant is not one the selected detector has. Pick one from the list.
rule.backend_item_overrides.not_a_mappin: A detector's per-label settings must be a set of labels, each with its own settings.
rule.backend_item_overrides.unknown_keys: This detector's per-label block has settings it cannot tune. Looks are set in the shared per-label block.
rule.backend_item_overrides.unknown_labe: This detector's per-label block names a label that does not exist.
rule.censor_overlap_strategy.missing_typ: A censor style in use has no overlap strategy. Add one for that style type.
rule.class_promotion.anywhere_with_bound: A promotion rule that matches anywhere cannot also set an overlap limit. Remove one of them.
rule.class_promotion.from_is_target: A promotion rule cannot promote a label to itself.
rule.class_promotion.missing_from: A promotion rule needs the label it promotes from.
rule.class_promotion.not_a_mapping: Promotion rules must be a set of target labels, each with its own rules.
rule.class_promotion.target_not_rendered: A promotion rule targets a label that is not hidden, so promoted boxes would show. Hide it, or remove the rule.
rule.class_promotion.unknown_keys: A promotion rule has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.class_promotion.unknown_label: A promotion rule names a label that does not exist.
rule.class_suppression.bad_refused_pair: Each refused pair must name two existing labels, one suppressing the other.
rule.class_suppression.duplicate_suppres: Two suppression rules for this label name the same suppressor. Merge them into one.
rule.class_suppression.missing_margin: A suppression rule needs a margin. Use 0 to rely on overlap alone.
rule.class_suppression.missing_min_iou: A suppression rule needs a minimum overlap.
rule.class_suppression.missing_suppresse: A suppression rule needs the label that suppresses.
rule.class_suppression.negative_margin: A suppression margin cannot be below 0. Use 0 to rely on overlap alone.
rule.class_suppression.not_a_mapping: Suppression settings are not in the expected shape: rules per label, or a list of refused pairs.
rule.class_suppression.removed_setting: The old shared suppression rules are no longer read. Move them into a detector's own settings.
rule.class_suppression.unknown_keys: A suppression rule has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.class_suppression.unknown_label: A suppression rule names a label that does not exist.
rule.config.unclassified: A check found a problem it has no description for. The app log has the details.
rule.cross_size_dedup.not_a_mapping: Cross-size duplicate removal must have an on or off switch and an overlap threshold.
rule.cross_size_dedup.unknown_keys: Cross-size duplicate removal has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.default_censor_style.missing: There is no default censor style. Choose one.
rule.detector_backend.not_a_mapping: The detector settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.detector_backend.unknown_backend: The selected detector is not one this app has. Pick one from the list.
rule.detector_backend.unknown_sections: The detector settings have a section for a detector that does not exist. Check for a typo.
rule.geometry_action.bad_value: What to do when a box breaks a size or shape limit must be one of the listed choices.
rule.geometry_action.unknown_bounds: A size or shape limit action can only be set for the lower and upper limit.
rule.item_overrides.not_a_mapping: A label's settings must be a set of named settings.
rule.item_overrides.tunable_in_shared_bl: Detection and tracking settings in the shared per-label block are no longer read. Set them per detector.
rule.item_overrides.unknown_keys: The shared per-label block has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.item_overrides.unknown_label: The shared per-label block names a label that does not exist.
rule.items_to_censor.missing: The list of what to hide is missing.
rule.label.area_bounds_crossed: The smallest box size limit must be below the largest, or every box breaks a limit.
rule.label.aspect_bounds_crossed: The narrowest box shape limit must be below the widest, or every box breaks a limit.
rule.label.hysteresis_below_floor: The keep-tracking threshold is at or below the global floor, so it does nothing. Raise it.
rule.label.hysteresis_inverted: The keep-tracking threshold must be below the start-tracking threshold.
rule.label.track_gap_below_interpolation: The track gap is shorter than the fill-in gap, so the longer fill-ins never happen.
rule.local_config.line_not_applied: A line in your settings file could not be read and was not used.
rule.logging.log_path_required: Logging is on but there is no log file. Set one, or turn logging off.
rule.min_prob.default_below_floor: The default confidence is at or below the global floor, so it rejects nothing. Raise it.
rule.min_prob.label_below_floor: This label's confidence is at or below the global floor, so it rejects nothing. Raise it.
rule.nn_batch_size.removed_setting: The old shared batch size is no longer read. Set it in the detector defaults or per detector.
rule.person_backend.model_missing: Person windows are on but the person model file is missing. Install it, or turn person windows off.
rule.person_backend.not_a_mapping: The person model settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.person_backend.picture_size_not_a_s: This person model's picture size is fixed by its file. Pick a model variant instead.
rule.person_backend.size_not_multiple_of: The person model's picture size must be a multiple of 32 above 0.
rule.person_backend.unknown_keys: The person model settings name a person model that does not exist.
rule.person_backend.unknown_variant: This variant is not one the person model has. Pick one from the list.
rule.person_windows.below_floor: The person evidence threshold is below the global floor, so weaker detections are never kept.
rule.person_windows.empty_list: The person evidence labels need at least one label.
rule.person_windows.male_and_female: A label cannot be male and female evidence at once.
rule.person_windows.not_a_mapping: The person window settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.person_windows.unknown_keys: The person window settings have a setting they do not know. Check for a typo.
rule.picture_sizes.duplicates: A picture size is listed twice, which would find every box twice. Remove the copy.
rule.picture_sizes.empty: There are no picture sizes for this detector. Set at least one.
rule.picture_sizes.not_sizes: Picture sizes must be whole numbers, 0 or more.
rule.picture_sizes.removed_setting: The old shared picture sizes are no longer read. Set them per detector.
rule.profiles.default_unknown: The default profile names a profile that does not exist.
rule.profiles.forced_unknown_profile: The forced profile names a profile the selected detector does not have.
rule.profiles.not_a_mapping: The profile settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.profiles.path_pattern_not_string: A path pattern for profiles must be text.
rule.profiles.path_pattern_unknown_profi: A path pattern names a profile the selected detector does not have.
rule.profiles.source_dir_absolute: Profile folders are named inside the videos folder, not by a full path.
rule.profiles.source_dir_climbs: A profile folder points above the videos folder, so it can never match.
rule.profiles.source_dir_duplicate: Two profile folders are the same folder spelled differently. Keep one.
rule.profiles.source_dir_empty_key: A profile folder has no name.
rule.profiles.source_dir_matches_everyth: A profile folder would match every video. Name a real folder, or remove it.
rule.profiles.source_dir_unknown_profile: A profile folder names a profile the selected detector does not have.
rule.profiles.threshold_for_other_signal: A profile sets a threshold for a signal it does not match on, so it never matches by itself.
rule.profiles.unknown_keys: A profile has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse.not_a_mapping: The reverse mode settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.reverse.unknown_keys: The reverse mode settings have a setting they do not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse_censor.not_a_mapping: The reverse mode censor settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.reverse_censor.override_not_censore: A reverse mode censor setting is for a label that is not censored there, so it never applies.
rule.reverse_censor.unknown_keys: The reverse mode censor settings have a setting they do not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse_censor.window_and_censored: A label cannot be both a window and censored in reverse mode. Remove it from one.
rule.reverse_frame_style.bad_type: This style cannot cover a whole frame. Use a blur or a pixel style.
rule.reverse_frame_style.not_a_mapping: The frame style must be one style.
rule.reverse_frame_style.too_slow: This style is too slow over a whole frame. Use a box or triple box blur, or mosaic pixels.
rule.reverse_trigger.below_floor: The trigger threshold is below the global floor. Set it at or above the floor.
rule.reverse_trigger.empty_list: The trigger labels must be every censored label, or a list of at least one label.
rule.reverse_trigger.not_a_mapping: The reverse mode trigger settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.reverse_trigger.unknown_keys: The reverse mode trigger settings have a setting they do not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse_window_style.empty_list: A window style needs at least one style.
rule.reverse_window_style.not_show: A window always shows the original. To hide this label in reverse mode, censor it instead.
rule.reverse_window_style.unknown_keys: A window style has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse_windows.not_a_mapping: The reverse mode windows must be a set of labels, each with its own settings.
rule.reverse_windows.unknown_keys: A window has a setting it does not know. Check for a typo.
rule.reverse_windows.unknown_label: A window names a label that does not exist.
rule.stats.stats_path_required: Stats are on but there is no stats file. Set one, or turn stats off.
rule.style.empty_list: A style list needs at least one style.
rule.style.missing_type: A style needs a type, such as blur or pixels.
rule.style.not_a_mapping: A style is not in the expected shape.
rule.style.sticker_needs_images: A sticker style needs a folder or a list of images to use.
rule.style.unknown_keys: A style has a setting its type does not use. Check for a typo.
rule.style.unknown_type: A style has a type that does not exist. Pick one from the list.
rule.type_default_shapes.not_a_mapping: The default shape per style type is not in the expected shape.
rule.type_default_shapes.unknown_type: A default shape is set for a style type that does not exist.
rule.variant_item_overrides.not_a_mappin: A detector's model variant settings are not in the expected shape.
rule.variant_item_overrides.unknown_keys: This model variant's per-label block has settings it cannot tune.
rule.variant_item_overrides.unknown_labe: This model variant's per-label block names a label that does not exist.
rule.variant_item_overrides.unknown_vari: Settings are given for a model variant the detector does not have, so they never apply.
